subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate idiom to fill in the blank.

The team always _______ to come up with unique advertisements for all its clients.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom "**thinks outside the box**" means to think creatively and not follow conventional ideas or approaches. (रूढ़िवादी तरीकों से अलग सोचना)
 
• In this context, it suggests** that the team always comes up with unique and creative advertisements for its clients**.
 
• The other options: "**throw caution to the winds**," "**take a back seat**," and "**turn the tables**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"The team always thinks outside the box__ to come up with unique advertisements for all its clients."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Throw caution to the winds (जोखिम उठाना)**: means to act in a daring way without worrying about the risk.
 
• **Take a back seat (कोई भूमिका न लेना)**: means to allow others to be in control or to take a less active role.
 
• **Turn the tables (स्थिति पलट देना)**: means to reverse the situation to gain an advantage over someone.

The correct answer is **Option 1**.</span&g
